page_title: Firefox: The fast, private browser that keeps you safe

summary.name: Firefox
summary.one_liner: Mozilla's independent web browser that blocks trackers by default and offers tab, reader, and sidebar tools, with optional AI features.
use_cases: switching browsers and importing bookmarks and passwords
watching video while working in other tabs
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Firefox as a web browser that blocks trackers automatically without setup. It offers tab groups, Firefox View, reader mode, picture-in-picture video, pinned tabs, and a customizable sidebar to manage browsing. When switching from another browser, bookmarks, passwords, and history can be brought over automatically. AI features are optional and can be customized or turned off entirely. Mozilla states it does not sell personal data.
notable: Automatic tracker blocking with no setup
Reader mode and picture-in-picture for less distraction
Optional AI features that can be turned off
Imports bookmarks, passwords, and history from other browsers
caveats: Meta description mentions a free built-in VPN, but the page text itself does not confirm it
Supported platforms are not named in the page text
